-- dep/go.mod --
module example.com/tupledep

go 1.27
-- dep/p/p.lgo --
package p

type Pair (int, int)
type Other (int, int)
type FieldTuple = (x int?, y int)
type Named (x int, y int)
type OptionalFields (x int?, y int)
type Box[T any] (T, T)

func Make() Pair { return (3, 4) }
func MakeOther() Other { return (3, 4) }
func MakeNamed() Named { return (9, 4) }
func (p Pair) Sum() int {
	var t (int, int) = p
	a, b := t
	return a + b
}
func (n Named) Diff() int { return n.x - n.y }
func (b Box[T]) First() T {
	var t (T, T) = b
	a, _ := t
	return a
}
func Fields(present bool) OptionalFields {
	var x int? = nil
	if present { x = 7 }
	return (x, 2)
}
func TupleFields(present bool) FieldTuple { return Fields(present) }

-- gostruct/go.mod --
module example.com/tuplestruct

go 1.27
-- gostruct/s/s.go --
package s

type Shape = struct { T_0 int; T_1 int }
type Bits struct { T_0 int; T_1 int }
type Named = struct { T_x int; T_y int }
func Make() Shape { return Shape{3, 4} }
func MakeNamed() Named { return Named{9, 4} }

-- app/go.mod --
module example.com/tupleapp

go 1.27

require (
	example.com/tupledep v0.0.0
	example.com/tuplestruct v0.0.0
)
replace example.com/tupledep => ../dep
replace example.com/tuplestruct => ../gostruct
-- app/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"example.com/tupledep/p"
	"example.com/tuplestruct/s"
)

func require(ok bool, name string) {
	if !ok { panic(name) }
}
func same[T any](a, b T) bool { return true }
type Tuple = (int, int)
type NamedTuple = (x int, y int)
func main() {
	var t (int, int) = (3, 4)
	var pair p.Pair = t
	var back (int, int) = pair
	require(pair.Sum() == 7 && back == t, "imported assignment both ways")
	require(pair == t && t == pair, "imported equality both ways")
	require(p.Pair(t).Sum() == 7 && Tuple(pair) == t, "imported conversions both ways")
	require(p.Pair.Sum(pair) == 7, "imported method expression")
	require(same(pair, t) && same(t, pair), "imported inference both orders")
	var shape s.Shape = pair
	var fromShape p.Pair = shape
	require(fromShape.Sum() == 7 && shape == pair && pair == shape, "Go struct assignment equality")
	var fromGo (int, int) = s.Make()
	var toGo s.Shape = fromGo
	require(toGo.T_0 == 3 && toGo.T_1 == 4, "Go struct tuple symmetry")
	bits := s.Bits(pair)
	require(p.Pair(bits).Sum() == 7, "defined Go struct conversions")
	other := p.Other(pair)
	require(p.Pair(other).Sum() == 7, "distinct defined conversion")
	var box p.Box[int] = t
	var boxBack (int, int) = box
	require(boxBack == t && p.Box[int](t).First() == 3, "imported generic conversion")
	require(p.Box[int].First(box) == 3, "generic method expression")
	var named p.Named = p.MakeNamed()
	require(named.x == 9 && named.y == 4 && named.Diff() == 5, "imported named fields methods")
	require(p.Named.Diff(named) == 5, "named method expression")
	var namedTuple (x int, y int) = named
	var namedBack p.Named = namedTuple
	var namedStruct s.Named = namedBack
	var fromNamedStruct p.Named = namedStruct
	require(fromNamedStruct.Diff() == 5 && namedTuple.x == 9, "named struct tuple assignment")
	require(named == namedTuple && namedTuple == named, "named equality")
	require(p.Named(namedTuple).Diff() == 5 && NamedTuple(named).y == 4, "named conversion")
	var present p.Named? = named
	var absent p.Named? = nil
	require((present?.x ?? -1) == 9 && (absent?.x ?? -1) == -1, "imported named optional selection")
	var importedStruct s.Named = s.MakeNamed()
	require(importedStruct.x == 9, "Go struct named source selector")
	var structPresent s.Named? = importedStruct
	var structAbsent s.Named? = nil
	require((structPresent?.x ?? -1) == 9 && (structAbsent?.x ?? -1) == -1, "Go struct optional selector")
	var full p.OptionalFields? = p.Fields(true)
	var empty p.OptionalFields? = p.Fields(false)
	var missing p.OptionalFields? = nil
	var fullField int? = full?.x
	var emptyField int? = empty?.x
	var missingField int? = missing?.x
	var anonymous ((x int?, y int)?) = p.TupleFields(true)
	var anonymousField int? = anonymous?.x
	require((anonymousField ?? -1) == 7, "imported anonymous optional field flattened")
	require((fullField ?? -1) == 7, "imported optional field present flattened")
	require((emptyField ?? -1) == -1 && (missingField ?? -1) == -1, "imported optional field absent flattened")
	fmt.Println("defined-tuples-foreign-ok")
}

-- goapp/go.mod --
module example.com/tuplegoapp

go 1.27

require example.com/tupledep v0.0.0
replace example.com/tupledep => ../dep
-- goapp/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"example.com/tupledep/p"
)

func main() {
	pair := p.Make()
	var shape struct { T_0 int; T_1 int } = pair
	var back p.Pair = shape
	if shape.T_0 != 3 || shape.T_1 != 4 || back.Sum() != 7 || pair != shape || shape != pair {
		panic("Go importer assignment equality")
	}
	type bits struct { T_0 int; T_1 int }
	b := bits(pair)
	if p.Pair(b).Sum() != 7 || p.Pair.Sum(pair) != 7 { panic("Go importer conversion methods") }
	named := p.MakeNamed()
	var namedShape struct { T_x int; T_y int } = named
	var namedBack p.Named = namedShape
	if namedShape.T_x != 9 || namedShape.T_y != 4 || p.Named.Diff(namedBack) != 5 {
		panic("Go importer named lowered fields")
	}
	var box p.Box[int] = shape
	if box.First() != 3 || p.Box[int].First(box) != 3 { panic("Go importer generic methods") }
	fmt.Println("defined-tuples-go-importer-ok")
}

-- reject/go.mod --
module example.com/tuplereject

go 1.27

require (
	example.com/tupledep v0.0.0
	example.com/tuplestruct v0.0.0
)
replace example.com/tupledep => ../dep
replace example.com/tuplestruct => ../gostruct
-- reject/forward/main.lgo --
package forward
import "example.com/tupledep/p"
var _ p.Other = p.Make()
-- reject/reverse/main.lgo --
package reverse
import "example.com/tupledep/p"
var _ p.Pair = p.MakeOther()
-- reject/struct_forward/main.lgo --
package struct_forward
import (
	"example.com/tupledep/p"
	"example.com/tuplestruct/s"
)
var _ s.Bits = p.Make()
-- reject/struct_reverse/main.lgo --
package struct_reverse
import (
	"example.com/tupledep/p"
	"example.com/tuplestruct/s"
)
var b s.Bits
var _ p.Pair = b
-- reject/equality/main.lgo --
package equality
import "example.com/tupledep/p"
var _ = p.Make() == p.MakeOther()

-- reject/missing_field/main.lgo --
package missing_field
var tuple (x int, y string)
var _ = tuple.z
-- reject/missing_defined_field/main.lgo --
package missing_defined_field
import "example.com/tupledep/p"
var _ = p.MakeNamed().z
-- reject/inference_forward/main.lgo --
package inference_forward
import "example.com/tupledep/p"
func same[T any](a, b T) bool { return true }
var _ = same(p.Make(), p.MakeOther())
-- reject/inference_reverse/main.lgo --
package inference_reverse
import "example.com/tupledep/p"
func same[T any](a, b T) bool { return true }
var _ = same(p.MakeOther(), p.Make())
-- reject/equality_elements/main.lgo --
package equality_elements
import "example.com/tupledep/p"
var tuple (int, string)
var _ = p.Make() == tuple
-- reject/tagged_forward/main.lgo --
package tagged_forward
var t (int, int)
var _ struct {
	T_0 int `json:"a"`
	T_1 int
} = t
-- reject/tagged_reverse/main.lgo --
package tagged_reverse
var s struct {
	T_0 int `json:"a"`
	T_1 int
}
var _ (int, int) = s
-- reject/embedded_forward/main.lgo --
package embedded_forward
type T_0 int
var t (T_0, int)
var _ struct {
	T_0
	T_1 int
} = t
-- reject/embedded_reverse/main.lgo --
package embedded_reverse
type T_0 int
var s struct {
	T_0
	T_1 int
}
var _ (T_0, int) = s
